name: Yvette Salva Fitness
what_they_do: Private, women-only personal training studio on Main St offering one-trainer/one-client sessions in private suites (Pilates reformers, TRX, kettlebells, cables), hybrid in-studio or virtual training, and 1:1 emotional-eating coaching. Sells 10-session packages priced $500-$950 depending on session length and whether Yvette trains you, with no monthly contracts.
customers: Women over 40 in Spotswood and surrounding Middlesex County towns; beginners, post-menopause, GLP-1 users and women returning to exercise.

size_signals.signal: Team described as 'our female fitness professionals' (no individual trainer names beyond Yvette Salva) in a single private studio at 529 Main Street
Published package pricing: $500 (10x30min), $750 (10x45min), $850 (10x60min), $600/$850/$950 when training with Yvette

listing.platform: Google (via maps result in search; rating also mirrored in a Trustindex widget claiming 108 reviews)

website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact' link in the nav; body copy says 'Text to schedule a consultation' (text 732-353-8529) - there is no book/quote button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No online booking or self-serve quote; the Contact page has a Contact Form 7 form (Name, Email, Phone, Message) guarded by a reCAPTCHA widget
website_review.trust_signals: 5.0 rating badge/review widget (Trustindex), studio photos of real sessions, founder story (About Yvette), detailed objection-handling copy, published package prices, Facebook page link
website_review.out_of_date_signs: None obvious - mobile layout is clean and current; the studio-hours line only says 'by appointment only' rather than listing hours
website_review.search_basics: Titles name the business and page but not the town ('Yvette Salva Fitness | All Women Fitness Studio'); meta description is absent on the home page; a dedicated Personal Training page exists, but no separate page for the Spotswood service area or for the emotional-eating coaching in the title pattern
top_issues: No online scheduling or consultation booking - every lead has to text, call or fill a form and wait
The only form is on the Contact page and sits behind a reCAPTCHA check
No LocalBusiness JSON-LD (only a Trustindex Organization block pointing at trustindex.io), so no address, hours or price markup for agents
No opening hours and no service-area/town text in titles or meta description

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt allows everything except WooCommerce logs and cart query strings, so OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot are fine; sitemap present; Google listing at 5.0 with 77 reviews. Answerable: package prices ($500-$950) are written as real text and the home page explains who it is for, but hours are only 'by appointment' and the JSON-LD is a third-party review widget, not a LocalBusiness record with address/hours/priceRange. Bookable: a labelled-looking contact form with text placeholders exists and the phone is click-to-call, but there is no calendar and the form is gated by a reCAPTCHA before submission.

operations_signals.signal: Booking is manual: 'Personal Training is by appointment only', with a text number for scheduling and a form as the only async path
High review volume relative to a one-studio, appointment-only business (5.0 across 77 Google reviews, widget claims 108) implies meaningful enquiry volume handled by hand

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add self-serve consultation booking (Calendly/Booksy-style or a lightweight scheduler) with an automated reminder and no-show follow-up
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page states training is by appointment only and directs people to text or call; no calendar anywhere on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Lead-response agent for form/text enquiries: answer the standard objections (never worked out, too old, GLP-1, pricing) with the studio's own copy and push to a booked consult
top_opportunities.evidence: Site already scripts six common objections in FAQ-style text, and the only conversion path is a reCAPTCHA-gated form or a text message

top_opportunities.opportunity: Local SEO + schema pass: LocalBusiness JSON-LD with address, hours, priceRange and services, town in titles/meta, and a Google Business Profile completeness check
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page has no meta description, titles omit the town, and the only structured data is a Trustindex Organization block

scores.reasons: Gap: solid site with good copy and prices, but no booking, no LocalBusiness schema and thin local SEO. Pay: appointment-only studio selling $500-$950 packages - enough ticket size, small headcount. Ease: adding a scheduler and schema to a WordPress site is a short job. Evidence: pricing, hours language, form fields and structured data all read directly off the live pages.
